categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 『魔神英雄伝ワタル』より、プラモデルオリジナル解釈の高頭身アレンジを施した「龍王丸」がHG Amplified IMGN で立体化！
description.en: From "Mashin Hero Wataru ", " Ryuomaru" with a tall head and body arrangement based on the plastic model's original interpretation is now three-dimensional with HG Amplified IMGN!

description.ja: 高頭身ならではのアクションや鳳王形態への変形で、龍王丸の魅力を“増幅”！
description.en: “Amplify” Ryuomaru’s charm with actions unique to his tall body and transformation into Houou form!

description.ja: • 「HG Amplified IMGN」とは、プラモデルというプロダクトの概念から、新たなアレンジを想像し、キャラクターの魅力を“増幅”していくシリーズ。
description.en: • "HG Amplified IMGN " is a series that imagines new arrangements based on the product concept of plastic models and " amplifies" the charm of the characters.

description.ja: • 全長約170mmの迫力アクション！高頭身ならではの長い手足を活かしたアクションが、龍王丸の新たなる魅力を“増幅”！
description.en: • Powerful action with a total length of approximately 170mm! Actions that take advantage of the long limbs unique to his tall head and body “amplify” Ryuomaru’s new charm!

description.ja: • 額は紋様の有無を選択式で再現可能。
description.en: • The forehead can be reproduced by selecting whether or not there is a pattern.

description.ja: • グロスインジェクション成形とゴールドメッキパーツを採用。高密度な造形で鮮やかな質感を表現。
description.en: • Adopts gloss injection molding and gold plated parts. Expressing a vivid texture with high-density modeling.

description.ja: • 鳳龍剣の刀身はゴールドメッキ仕様。オリジナルデザインの紋様は3Dメタリックシールで再現。
description.en: • The blade of the Horyuken is gold plated. The original design pattern is reproduced with 3D metallic seal.

description.ja: • 鞘盾は鳳王形態用の開閉ギミックを搭載。鳳龍剣の収納も可能。
description.en: • The scabbard shield is equipped with an opening/closing gimmick for the Phoenix King form. It is also possible to store the Horyuken.

description.ja: • 鳳王形態への変形が可能。鳳王形態時に装着できるプラモデルオリジナルのPET シート製のエフェクトが付属。高頭身アレンジだけでなく、オリジナルエフェクトで龍王丸の魅力を“増幅”。
description.en: • Can transform into Houou form. Comes with effects made from plastic model original PET sheet that can be attached when in Houou form. In addition to the tall arrangement, Ryuomaru's charm is "amplified" with original effects.

description.ja: • 肩の龍爪を付属台座へ取り付けることで「龍牙拳」の再現が可能。
description.en: • "Ryugaken" can be reproduced by attaching the dragon claw on the shoulder to the attached pedestal.

description.ja: • ディスプレイ用の台座も付属。
description.en: • A pedestal for display is also included.

accessories.ja: エフェクト用PET シート×1式
台座用ジョイントパーツ×1
